From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Sri Harsha of Kanauj. A monograph on the history of India in the first half of the 7th century A.D. · Panikkar, K. M. (Kavalam Madhava), 1896-1963 · 1922, 96 scanned pages. Published 1922; Kavalam Madhava Panikkar died 1963; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
